label: UniFi U7 Pro XG Wall
description: UniFi U7 Pro XG Wall (U7-Pro-XG-Wall) - 1x 10G RJ45. 802.3at PoE-in; WiFi 7; up to 5.8 Gbps PHY rate; 22 W max.
notes: PoE draw read 2026-11-28 from https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/u7-pro-xg-wall (HTTP 200, 652,465 B): the specification table prints "Power Method: PoE+" and "Max. Power Consumption: 22W". 22 W is that figure and it sits on eth0, the single RJ45 the same table's Networking Interface row names. Until this pass the port carried no poeIn at all, so engine/media.js fell back to its 12.95 W 802.3af class default and the model drew 12.95 W whatever the datasheet said. Nothing in the engine compares a PD's draw with the class its PSE declared, so cabling this AP to an 802.3af port is still accepted; the number changes the budget arithmetic, which is the one thing a PoE lab asks of it.
